# Assessment Overview

- [data-architecture.md](./data-architecture.md) - Database configuration, entity model, repository methods, and data ownership boundaries.
- [configuration-inventory.md](./configuration-inventory.md) - Configuration sources, runtime/build profiles, properties, and sensitive settings inventory.
- [business-workflows.md](./business-workflows.md) - Core domain workflows, service-domain mapping, and business decision logic.
